capabilities: create journal entries from templates with a date-prefixed name
file dated notes into year/month folders and move misplaced entries with confirmation
browse entries in a hub view with timeline, list and calendar modes
show writing activity as a GitHub-style grid with streak statistics
generate a Markdown hub note linking to every entry
extras: Standalone by design: the README states it needs no Templater or Dataview, has no network access or telemetry, and works on desktop and mobile from Obsidian 1.15.0.
intentEvidence: Daily-notes plugins give you one note per day with a fixed name. Journal Hub is for a journal where each entry has its own name
motivation: The author wanted a journal where each entry has its own name, several entries can exist per day, and the whole journal can be browsed by year and month, unlike fixed-name daily notes.
problem: Daily-notes plugins create one fixed-name note per day, which doesn't fit journals with multiple titled entries per day that need automatic filing and browsing.
summary: Journal plugin that creates dated entries from templates, files them into year/month folders, and offers a hub view, activity grid and Markdown index.
